question: From the first year each actor appeared in a film to the last, how many actors in the database never had a gap longer than three consecutive years without at least one new movie appearance, meaning there is no four-year span anywhere in their active career without at least a single film credit?
sql:
WITH actor_years AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT mc.PID, TRY_CAST(m.year AS INTEGER) AS yr
  FROM M_Cast mc
  JOIN Movie m ON mc.MID = m.MID
  WHERE TRY_CAST(m.year AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT PID, yr, LAG(yr) OVER (PARTITION BY PID ORDER BY yr) as prev_yr,
         yr - LAG(yr) OVER (PARTITION BY PID ORDER BY yr) as gap
  FROM actor_years
),
actors_with_gap_gt_4 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PID FROM gaps WHERE gap > 4
),
all_actors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PID FROM actor_years
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_actors WHERE PID NOT IN (SELECT PID FROM actors_with_gap_gt_4)
